image_prompt: A middle-aged Lutheran bishop in his late forties to early fifties, with a gaunt, careworn face reflecting financial hardship and loss. The overall appearance conveys somber religious severity, faded aristocratic bearing, and the physical manifestation of political and economic decline in 18th century northern German Protestant clergy.
